% Floats and a wide part in a revtex4-2 article. revtex4.4ht
% configures these as well as the headings.
\documentclass{revtex4-2}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead floats}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{Floats}
Text before the floats.
\begin{table}
\caption{A small table.}\label{tab:one}
\begin{ruledtabular}
\begin{tabular}{cc}
a & b\\
c & d
\end{tabular}
\end{ruledtabular}
\end{table}
\begin{table*}
\caption{A wide table.}
\begin{ruledtabular}
\begin{tabular}{cc}
e & f
\end{tabular}
\end{ruledtabular}
\end{table*}
\begin{widetext}
Text of the wide part, and table~\ref{tab:one}.
\end{widetext}
\begin{figure}
\caption{A figure.}\label{fig:one}
\end{figure}
\begin{figure*}
\caption{A wide figure.}
\end{figure*}
Text after figure~\ref{fig:one}.
\end{document}
